name: core_engine
description: Graph extraction and construction pipeline. Parses Python AST, builds structural graph (graph0), classifies layers, filters edges, builds call-graph workflow.
intent: Graph extraction and construction pipeline. Parses Python AST, builds structural graph (graph0), classifies layers, filters edges, builds call-graph workflow.

components.name: extractor
components.description: AST parser. Extracts nodes (functions, classes, modules) from Python source files.

components.name: workflow_builder
components.description: Builds function-level call graph (workflow.json) from extracted AST data.

components.name: layers
components.description: Classifies nodes into layers: stdlib, external, internal_lib, project, test.

components.name: filters
components.description: Edge filtering pipeline removing stdlib, dunder, test-harness, and logging edges.

components.name: annotator
components.description: Manages intent annotations (graph1). Tracks body hashes to detect stale intents.

rules.reason: Models are pure data. They must not import engine modules.
